name: @stagepilot/desktop
description: Tauri v2 shell for the StagePilot dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.build:ci: npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.ci.conf.json
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:help && npm run build:sidecar && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.macos.conf.json
